En mi niit alilis lon pwal eu kapas? Sipwe angei emon chon chiaku ngonuk ese kamo. Kokori (808) 831-7921 omw kopwe ureni kich meni kapas ka ani.

Makemake ʻoe i kokua i pili kekahi ʻolelo o na ʻaina ʻe? Makemake la maua i kiʻi ʻoe mea unuhi manuahi. E kelepona (808) 831-7921 ʻoe ia la kaua a e haʻina ʻoe ia la maua mea ʻolelo o na ʻaina ʻe.

Masapulyo kadi ti tulong iti sabali a pagsasao? Ikkandakayo iti libre nga paraipatarus. Awaganyo ti (808) 831-7921 tapno ibagayo kadakami no ania ti pagsasao nga ar-aramatenyo.

貴方は、他の言語に、助けを必要としていますか ? 私たちは、貴方のために、無料で 通訳を用意で きます。電話番号の、(808) 831-7921 に、電話して、私たちに貴方の話されている言語を申し出てください。

다른언어로 도움이 필요하십니까? 저희가 무료로 통역을 제공합니다. (808) 831-7921 로 전화해서 사용하는 언어를 알려주십시요

Kwoj aikuij ke jiban kin juon bar kajin? Kim naj lewaj juon am dri ukok eo ejjelok wonen. Kirtok (808) 831-7921 im kwalok non kim kajin ta eo kwo melele im kenono kake.

E te mana’o mia se fesosoani i se isi gagana? Matou te fesosoani e ave atu fua se faaliliu upu mo oe. Vili mai i le numera lea (808) 831-7921 pea e mana’o mia se fesosoani mo se faaliliu upu.

¿Necesita ayuda en otro idioma? Nosotros le ayudaremos a conseguir un intérprete gratuito. Llame al (808) 831-7921 y diganos que idioma habla.

Kailangan ba ninyo ng tulong sa ibang lengguwahe? Ikukuha namin kayo ng libreng tagasalin. Tumawag sa (808) 831-7921 para sabihin kung anong lengguwahe ang nais ninyong gamitin.

คุณต้องการความช่วยเหลือทางด้านภาษาหรือไม่ ทางเราจะจัดหาล่ามฟรีให้คุณ โทรที่เบอร์ (808) 831-7921 และบอกเราว่าคุณพูดภาษาอะไร

Bạn có cần giúp đỡ bằng ngôn ngữ khác không ? Chúng tôi se yêu cầu một người thông dịch viên miễn phí cho bạn. Gọi (808) 831-7921 nói cho chúng tôi biết bạn dùng ngôn ngữ nào.

Gakinahanglan ka ba ug tabang sa imong pinulongan? Amo kang mahatagan ug libre nga maghuhubad. Tawag sa (808) 831-7921 aron magpahibalo kung unsa ang imong sinulti-han.

Kaua‘i Lane Closures

FOR THE WEEK OF OCT. 10 – Oct. 16

 

PLEASE NOTE:

 Lane closure schedules may change at any time without further notice. All projects are weather permitting. A map of lane closures can be found here, https://hidot.hawaii.gov/highways/roadwork/

For updates on closures due to the impact of Hurricane Lowell visit the Hawaii State Department of Transportation Weather Page here, https://hidot.hawaii.gov/weather-traffic/

 

ADDED 10/14

1) WAILUA (NIGHT/DAY WORK)

Single lane closure on Kuhio Highway (Route 56), possible in either direction near milepost 5.9 in the vicinity of Kuamoo Road on Wednesday, Oct. 15 from 1 a.m. to 9:30 a.m. for emergency repairs to the traffic signal controls.

 

— KAUMUALII HIGHWAY (ROUTE 50) —

 

1) PUHI (24/7)

Left turn lane closure on Kaumualii Highway (Route 50), in the eastbound direction near milepost 1.7 in the vicinity of Puhi Road on Saturday, Oct. 10 to Friday, Oct. 16 for pavement repairs. Detour to Nuhou Street for access to KCC.

 

2) OMAO

Shoulder closure on Kaumualii Highway (Route 50), possible in either direction near milepost 5.3 in the vicinity of halfway bridge on Monday, Oct. 12 to Friday, Oct. 16 from 8:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. for guardrail repair.

 

3) LAWAI

Single lane closure on Kaumualii Highway (Route 50), possible in either direction between milepost 9.6 to 9.9 in the vicinity of Piko Road and Akemama Road on Sunday, Oct. 11 to Friday, Oct. 16 from 11:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. for installing a raised crosswalk. Details: https://hidot.hawaii.gov/highways/raised-crosswalk-installations-on-kuhio-and-kaumuali%ca%bbi-highways-rescheduled-due-to-lowell/

 

— RICE STREET (ROUTE 51) —

 

1) NAWILIWILI

Single lane closure on Rice Street (Route 51),possible in either direction between milepost 0.2 to 0.7 in the vicinity of Kalapaki Road and Mokoi Street on Monday, Oct. 12 to Friday, Oct. 16 from 11:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. for landscape maintenance.

 

— KUHIO HIGHWAY (ROUTES 56/560) —

1) WAILUA (NIGHT/DAY WORK)

Single lane closure on Kuhio Highway (Route 56), possible in either direction near milepost 5.9 in the vicinity of Kuamoo Road on Wednesday, Oct. 15 from 1 a.m. to 9:30 a.m. for emergency repairs to the traffic signal controls.

2) ANAHOLA

Single lane closure on Kuhio Highway (Route 56), possible in either direction between milepost 12.8 to 13.1 in the vicinity of Ioane Road and Kalalea Road on Sunday, Oct. 11 to Friday, Oct. 16 from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m. for installation of a raised crosswalk. Details: https://hidot.hawaii.gov/blog/2026/09/18/raised-crosswalk-installations-on-kuhio-and-kaumuali%CA%BBi-highways-rescheduled-due-to-lowell/

 

3) ANAHOLA TO MOLOAA

Single lane closure on Kuhio Highway (Route 56), possible in either direction between milepost 16 to 19 in the vicinity of Kapuna Road on Monday Oct. 12 to Friday, Oct. 16 from 7:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. for landscape maintenance.

 

4) MOLOAA to KILAUEA

Single lane closure on Kuhio Highway (Route 56), possible in either direction between milepost 19 to 21.5 in the vicinity of Kapuna Road and Wailapa Road on Monday Oct. 12 to Friday, Oct. 16 from 7:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. for storm debris removal.

 

— WAIMEA CANYON DRIVE (ROUTE 550) —

 

1) KOKEE

Single lane closure on Waimea Canyon Drive (Route 550), possible in either direction between milepost 6.7 to 7.2, in the vicinity of Kokee Road, on Friday, Oct.16 from 7 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. for shoulder widening.
